phaser-multi-phase-coordination-concept-.title: Coordinate repeated phases with Phaser
phaser-multi-phase-coordination-concept-.summary: Phaser coordinates a changing number of participating tasks over repeated synchronization phases.
phaser-multi-phase-coordination-concept-.why: It is useful when work proceeds in stages and participants may register or deregister dynamically.
phaser-multi-phase-coordination-concept-.tips: Ensure every registered party eventually arrives or deregisters.

delayqueue-expiring-elements-concept-035.title: Schedule delayed elements with DelayQueue
delayqueue-expiring-elements-concept-035.short: Take elements only after their delay expires
delayqueue-expiring-elements-concept-035.summary: DelayQueue stores Delayed elements and makes them available only after their delay has expired.
delayqueue-expiring-elements-concept-035.why: It can model expiration and deferred work without repeatedly scanning timestamps.
delayqueue-expiring-elements-concept-035.tips: Ordering is based on the remaining delay of each element.

files-mismatch-first-difference-035.title: Find the first differing byte between files
files-mismatch-first-difference-035.summary: Files.mismatch compares two files and returns the position of the first differing byte, or -1 when they match.
files-mismatch-first-difference-035.why: It avoids manually opening streams and comparing buffers.
files-mismatch-first-difference-035.tips: Handle IOException and remember that the returned value is a byte offset.

unmappable-character-exception-encoding-.title: Handle characters that an encoder cannot represent
unmappable-character-exception-encoding-.summary: UnmappableCharacterException reports input characters that cannot be represented by the target charset.
unmappable-character-exception-encoding-.why: Not every Unicode character has a representation in every charset.
unmappable-character-exception-encoding-.tips: Choose REPORT, REPLACE, or IGNORE according to the data contract rather than silently losing text.

not-yet-connected-exception-channel-035.title: Use a SocketChannel before it is connected
not-yet-connected-exception-channel-035.summary: NotYetConnectedException occurs when an operation requiring a connected socket channel is attempted too early.
not-yet-connected-exception-channel-035.why: Opening a channel alone does not always establish a connection to a peer.
not-yet-connected-exception-channel-035.tips: Use SocketChannel.open(address) or complete connect before reading or writing.

multi-catch-subtype-alternatives-error-0.title: Put related exception subtypes in one multi-catch
multi-catch-subtype-alternatives-error-0.short: Do not combine a type with its subtype
multi-catch-subtype-alternatives-error-0.summary: Multi-catch alternatives cannot be related by subclassing, such as IOException and FileNotFoundException.
multi-catch-subtype-alternatives-error-0.why: Catching the supertype already includes the subtype, making the second alternative redundant.
multi-catch-subtype-alternatives-error-0.tips: Catch the common supertype or use separate catch blocks when behavior differs.

record-extra-instance-field-error-035.title: Declare an extra instance field in a record
record-extra-instance-field-error-035.short: Keep record instance state in components
record-extra-instance-field-error-035.summary: A record cannot declare additional instance fields beyond its record components.
record-extra-instance-field-error-035.why: The record header defines the complete instance state represented by the record.
record-extra-instance-field-error-035.tips: Use another record component, a static field, or a regular class when extra state is required.

serial-lint-missing-serialversionuid-war.title: Detect missing serialVersionUID
serial-lint-missing-serialversionuid-war.short: Use the serial lint warning for Serializable classes
serial-lint-missing-serialversionuid-war.summary: The serial lint category can warn when a Serializable class lacks an explicit serialVersionUID.
serial-lint-missing-serialversionuid-war.why: An explicit identifier makes serialization compatibility intent clearer across class changes.
serial-lint-missing-serialversionuid-war.tips: Declare serialVersionUID when Java serialization compatibility is part of the design.

identityhashmap-value-equality-trap-035.title: Use IdentityHashMap for ordinary value keys
identityhashmap-value-equality-trap-035.summary: IdentityHashMap uses reference identity instead of equals when comparing keys.
identityhashmap-value-equality-trap-035.why: Two distinct but equal objects are intentionally treated as different keys.
identityhashmap-value-equality-trap-035.tips: Use HashMap for normal value equality and reserve IdentityHashMap for identity-based algorithms.

optional-map-null-becomes-empty-trap-035.title: Assume Optional.map preserves a null result
optional-map-null-becomes-empty-trap-035.short: A null mapping result becomes empty
optional-map-null-becomes-empty-trap-035.summary: Optional.map converts a null result from its mapping function into Optional.empty.
optional-map-null-becomes-empty-trap-035.why: Calling get afterward can fail even when the original Optional contained a value.
optional-map-null-becomes-empty-trap-035.tips: Keep mapping functions non-null where possible and use explicit fallback operations.
